_about: The explicit list of every page's menu and footer texts (Ruling 21:01, CEL-026 round 2). Built on 2026-10-19 from the LIVE English pages (https://www.englishcollege.com<path>), by tools/localize/align.py's own landmark finder (_Shape._landmark: a <nav> / role=navigation / role=banner / role=contentinfo, or a <footer> outside article, aside, main, nav, section): `landmark_texts` = every distinct text the parser read inside one, in page order. The desk's chrome rule is NOT used to build it. `kept_on_purpose` = landmark texts that are NOT dropped from the document, each with its reason (checked by hand); `outside_landmarks` = site chrome that sits in no landmark (the mobile call-to-action bar after the footer (class mobile-cta_apply-link, the text Apply now)), also dropped. The test asserts: dropped texts == landmark_texts - kept_on_purpose + outside_landmarks, for every page. A menu or footer text that falls below the 30-page rule shows up as a difference and is added to `landmark_texts` here, then to the desk's explicit chrome list.
